text:
maya: CI red on main — several integ jobs failing in the 'session-broker' mock layer after the last merge :grimacing:
ci-bot: Failed job: pipeline/integration/x86-ubuntu (build 8421) — test suite: tests/integration/test_session_handshake.py
ci-bot: Summary: 27 failed, 3 error, 102 passed. See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/8421
kevin: can't open the socket in the mock broker, looks like bind(0.0.0.0:0) is returning EADDRINUSE intermittently in the logs :thinking:
maya: snippet from job log:
```
2026-02-10T09:12:34Z ERROR session-broker: failed to bind listener: listen tcp 0.0.0.0:0: bind: address already in use
2026-02-10T09:12:34Z WARN  test harness: waiting for broker to be ready...
2026-02-10T09:12:40Z ERROR test_session_handshake: Timeout waiting for broker
```
kevin: I suspect the new docker-network change in infra-provisioning that reuses host ports for ephemeral containers. PR #1456 changed the runner network mode last week.
samir: I ran a local matrix and couldn't repro, but my runs are serial. This looks like a parallel-job packing problem where two containers try to claim the same ephemeral range.
maya: can someone bisect the window? It looks correlated with merges between commit a3f9c2 and d4b1f0 (last week).
jin: @kevin can you try a targeted rerun with DOCKER_NETMODE=bridge forced in pipeline env to confirm? If it goes green it's the runner change.
kevin: kicking off a rerun now with bridge mode on a single failing job (build 8421.2) — will report. :ok_hand:
ci-bot: Rerun queued: pipeline/integration/x86-ubuntu (build 8421.2) — started by kevin
kevin: first rerun failed with same bind error, second rerun passed when I bumped EPHEMERAL_PORT_RANGE to 40000-41000 in the container env. So likely port collision across parallel containers.
maya: ok. short-term: add randomization to mock broker bind (choose port within configurable range) and add retry/backoff on bind for 3 attempts. Tagging infra to roll a safe runner config revert.
kevin: opening a small patch to the test harness now. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1982 — adds retry + ENV EPHEMERAL_PORT_RANGE support.
samir: FYI I'll coordinate with infra to revert the network reuse change in the runner pool for next deploy window if we think it's risky.
jin: also adding a CI-only guard to avoid running these particular integration shards in parallel until we confirm.
maya: thanks all. if anyone sees other flaky failures from the same job ping here. I'll mark the impacted release blocking until infra and test fix land. :raised_hands:
